scope: External FEVER evidence-page identity proxy only; binary known-page nDCG, unlisted candidates unjudged. No passage relevance or factual accuracy claim.
limitations: Current search and lead extracts differ from FEVER 2017 sentence evidence; annotated pages may be renamed/missing.
No exhaustive passage annotations; absence from gold does not establish irrelevance. Page retrieval metrics cannot justify stance.
Source-page and near-claim separation do not ensure disjoint topics/families or absence from model pretraining.
MRR uses the full bounded list; recall denominator includes all annotated pages even absent from candidate pool.
Reranker failure/over-limit uses unchanged baseline order and is counted; never fabricated scores.
